correctness.rationale: For the 60 even permutations of 5, Walsh W=(per B+det B)/2 over integer signs. Row/column gauge masks dimension 9, so all F2^25 Fourier frequencies fall into 2^16 representatives repeated 512 times. An independent complete Walsh transform of 60 projected permutation masks reproduces 65,536-class absolute histogram {0:11320,4:24600,8:17400,12:7850,16:3720,20:360,24:200,28:60,36:25,60:1}, Parseval, full nullity 5,795,840, least positive magnitude 4, condition 15 and inverse-indicator kernel norm 266611/4096. Analytically even extensions of prescribed k<=3 compatible edges number (5-k)!/2, giving first zero at exactly three-edge paths, 400 on K5,5. Averaging arbitrary range projections over translations proves the canonical projection has minimum possible l1/l∞ norm. Enumeration is genuinely exhaustive only for order 5, and is the finite certificate not an infinite proof.
